exposure: Access to prenatal and postpartum healthcare services
outcome: Waiting time for high-risk delivery and neonatal intensive care
Laboratory tests in the third trimester
cohort: 1701 women who delivered a baby in an obstetric reference unit in the Health Macro-Region of Cariri, Ceará, Brazil from January to December 2015
finding: The study found a high C-section rate, long wait times for specialized care, and low utilization of essential prenatal and postpartum healthcare services, indicating gaps in access and completeness of care for pregnant women.
mod_finding: The study found a high rate of cesarean delivery (49.7%).
